visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman in a light-colored short-sleeved shirt and dark shorts stands in a living room with grey floor-to-ceiling curtains. She gestures with her hands while speaking directly to the camera in a bright, well-lit environment. (2) A large informative poster is displayed on screen, detailing a blind walk challenge for a guide dog association, featuring text, diagrams of a person with a guide dog, and photos of prizes. (3) The woman puts on a black blindfold and attempts to walk across the living room. On-screen text and a digital timer appear. A golden retriever and several children sitting on a sofa are visible in the background. (4) A young boy in a white T-shirt puts on the blindfold and runs across the room, nearly bumping into a dark brown door with a red lunar new year sticker. (5) A man in a black graphic T-shirt and black baseball cap puts on the blindfold and walks tentatively through the room, followed closely by the golden retriever on a leash. (6) A younger boy in a pink graphic T-shirt takes his turn walking blindfolded. (7) The woman returns to the camera, speaking and gesturing with high energy to provide a concluding message and call to action. (8) A final clip shows the man walking the guide dog, appearing slightly awkward as he navigates.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat and cheery electronic synth-pop BGM starts playing at a moderate volume. A woman's high-arousal, friendly voice introduces a challenge. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect marks the transition to the first attempt. The woman's voice becomes more animated and breathy as she navigates blindly, accompanied by soft laughter from kids in the background. (3) A digital clock ticking effect is audible underneath the speech. Another loud 'ding' sounds as she finishes, followed by her cheering. (4) A comic 'boing' sound effect triggers a new phase as a child starts running. The BGM maintains a steady beat. The sound of rapid, light footsteps on wood is heard. (5) A man's calm, low-pitch narrative voice takes over as he begins his turn. The dog's paws are heard lightly clicking on the floor. (6) A variety of cartoonish sound effects like slides and pops are edited in between speaker transitions. (7) The woman provides a closing narrative with high vocal dominance and a smiling tone, encouraging viewers to take action. (8) Final comical commentary from the man ends the audio track abruptly as the video loops.
